verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product whose agents generate fixes, push commits and run codebase scans, so sandboxed execution is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack describes the agent running in an isolated sandbox for code, tool or network access. The nearest items are shadow mode for auto-approval and RBAC for settings, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources
